title: Italian Chicken Cacciatore
description: Chicken thighs baked with a Mediterranean vegetable mix of onions, peppers, celery and mushrooms in a rich tomato and passata sauce.
ingredients: fresh herbs (parsley, basil, oregano), to serve
steps: Place onions, garlic, peppers, celery, mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, balsamic vinegar and Italian herbs in a deep baking tray; spray with cooking spray; roast 15 minutes.
Remove; stir vegetables; add chopped tomatoes, passata and chicken; season. Stir and return to oven for 20 minutes.
notes: Great for scaling up. Prepare vegetables in advance and cover with foil until ready to bake. Serve with Cannellini Bean Mash (p.147) or a rocket salad.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
